acceptedAnswer.text: To understand tiny home permit regulations in Vista, the primary resource is the City of Vista's official website, specifically their Planning and Building Departments. These departments provide access to local zoning ordinances, building codes, and application forms. They also offer contact information for planning staff who can answer specific questions regarding your project. Additionally, community development or housing authority websites might provide guides or FAQs related to ADUs and tiny homes. Consulting with a local firm like Zen Tiny Homes, familiar with Vista's specific codes, can also be a valuable resource.
